document.title: Security audit 2026-11-07 (10): browser instructions before opening the report

acknowledgments.summary: audit of pull request test/windows-verify before merge, directed by the maintainer

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Audit of a change to the end of verify-windows.ps1 and run-tests.ps1: the steps to follow in the browser are now shown before it opens, followed by a 'Press Enter to open the report' pause, because the browser window covered the instructions. No security issues found.

notes.title: Audit details
notes.text: Only console text, its order and one Read-Host pause changed; the URL, the clipboard contents and the File Explorer call are unchanged from logs 7 and 8. The value read by the new Read-Host is discarded. run-tests.ps1 now tracks the clipboard fallback with a boolean instead of looking for text in the URL.

notes.title: Result
notes.text: No findings. Logged as required by the project's audit policy.

revision_history.summary: Initial log of the pull request audit.
